card.name: Bible book abbreviations in citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a number just before an abbreviated Bible book name in a scripture reference, such as an opening parenthesis, a semicolon, or the 1 or 2 in '1 Cor.'. It expects the next word to be a book abbreviation.

modes.label: Book number
modes.description: The digit 1 or 2 that precedes a numbered book such as Cor., Tim. or Kings.

modes.label: Opening or separator mark
modes.description: A parenthesis or semicolon that begins a new scripture citation.
modes.example: God's promise through Jeremiah of a new covenant<< (>>Jer. 31:34)

card.writes: It promotes abbreviated Bible book names such as Matt, Jer, Gen, Tim and Prov.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a Bible citation where an abbreviated book name like Matt. or Jer. comes next.
